correctness.rationale: A rigorous sphere-erosion identity and antipodal vertex constraints establish the exact gap and threshold. Strict shorter-radius separation makes all nonmaximal vertices inactive near criticality. Anisotropic rescaling (delta in the farthest-vertex span, square-root delta orthogonal to it) and a bounded-level-set sandwich produce the sharp (d+s)/2 law with relative O(delta) error. The beta integral yields the polar coefficient. For rhombi an exact constraint maximum on the lens proves the shielding cutoff with positive-area strictness below it; dimension-sensitive polar calculations yield 4/3 and 1. The independent numerical script passed 20 quadrature/asymptotic checks; finite tests are not the proof.
